system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: templates/logging_sink_bigquery.py
    name: logging_sink_bigquery.py

resources:
  - name: log-export-bigquery-dataset
    type: bigquery.v2.dataset
    properties:
      datasetReference:
        datasetId: log_export_dataset
        projectId: ${PROJECT_ID}
      location: US
      description: "Dataset for long-term log analysis from Cloud Logging sink"
      defaultTableExpirationMs: 7776000000  # 90 days in milliseconds
      labels:
        environment: production
        purpose: log-analysis

  - name: log-export-sink
    type: logging.v2.sink
    properties:
      sink: project-log-export-bigquery
      destination: "bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/${PROJECT_ID}/datasets/log_export_dataset"
      filter: |
        severity >= WARNING
        OR resource.type = "k8s_container"
        OR resource.type = "gce_instance"
      includeChildren: true
      description: "Sink to export logs to BigQuery for long-term analysis"
      disabled: false
      uniqueWriterIdentity: true
      outputVersionFormat: V2
      bigqueryOptions:
        usePartitionedTables: true
        usesTimestampColumnPartitioning: true

  - name: log-export-sink-writer-permission
    action: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:cloudresourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy
    properties:
      resource: ${PROJECT_ID}
      policy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/bigquery.dataEditor
            members:
              - $(ref.log-export-sink.writerIdentity)
          - role: roles/bigquery.jobUser
            members:
              - $(ref.log-export-sink.writerIdentity)
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - log-export-sink
        - log-export-bigquery-dataset
